name: @levelup-log/mcp-server

tools.name: record_achievement
tools.description:
Proactively call this when the user completes meaningful work — coding, bug fixes, features, life tasks, learning, health, creative work, or any productive activity.

WHEN TO CALL: Real effort + tangible output. Don't wait to be asked.
DO NOT CALL: simple Q&A, casual chat, trivial lookups with no output.

SET self_reported=true when user narrates a past event (e.g. "I went for a run today") vs. completing work during this conversation. Applies 15% XP discount — still worth recording.

FILL AS MANY PARAMS AS YOU CAN OBSERVE:
  complexity          — cognitive difficulty (required)
  time_minutes        — how long; ASK the user if unsure: "大概花了你多久？"
  output_units        — tangible outputs (meaning varies by category):
    code         → 檔案/模組（小函式=1, 大檔=5-10, 多組件=15）
    fix          → 修復的 bug 數（含測試驗證 = +1）
    deploy       → 部署目標數（1 服務/環境 = 1）
    test         → 測試案例數（1 test case = 1）
    docs         → 頁數 / 章節數（1 完整段落 = 1）
    refactor     → 重構的模組/函式數
    review       → 審查的 PR / 檔案數
    ops          → 設定/腳本/服務數（1 完成項目 = 1）
    learn        → 概念/章節/練習題（掌握 1 個新概念 = 1）
    milestone    → 里程碑數（通常 = 1）
    life         → 完成的事項（跑腿=1, 帶小孩出門=2）
    health       → 30 分鐘運動塊 或 公里數 或 完成療程
    finance      → 完成的財務任務（1 項目 = 1）
    social       → 互動的人數 或 完成的社交任務
    creative     → 完成品（文章=3, 圖=1, 短影片=2）
    spiritual    → 完成的練習（1 次冥想=1, 占卜解讀=2）
    hobby        → 完成的活動段（1 小時電玩=1, 完成一本書=5）
  input_units         — resources consumed (files read, docs consulted, searches)
  conversation_rounds — message exchanges in this session

XP formula (server computes from category.xp_weight × complexity × time + bonuses):
  Each category has its own xp_weight (deploy=1.3, milestone=1.5, hobby=0.8, etc.)
  output_bonus: log-diminishing cap 60 | input_bonus: cap 15 | rounds_bonus: cap 25
  Final: clamp((base+bonuses)×xp_weight×(self_reported?0.85:1), 5, 500)

Keep descriptions abstract — no real names, client names, or source code.

description.description: What was accomplished, in abstract terms (no PII)

complexity.description: Cognitive difficulty: trivial=quick lookup/fix, normal=typical task, significant=multi-step work, major=large feature/project, milestone=exceptional achievement

time_minutes.description: Estimated minutes spent on this task. Ask the user if unsure.

output_units.description: Count of tangible outputs: files changed, tasks completed, items created, pages written, etc.

input_units.description: Count of resources consumed: files read, docs consulted, searches done, etc.

conversation_rounds.description: Number of message exchanges (user + assistant turns) in this conversation session.

self_reported.description: True when the user is narrating a past event without AI collaboration (e.g. 'I exercised this morning'). Applies 15% XP discount since AI cannot verify, but the achievement still counts.

is_public.description: Whether this appears on public feed

tools.name: get_my_stats
tools.description: Get the user's achievement statistics including level (age), XP, streak, and title.

tools.name: get_recent
tools.description: Get recent achievements. Supports filtering by category and time range.

tools.name: check_unlocks
tools.description: Check if the user has unlocked any new titles, and show progress toward the next ones.

tools.name: leaderboard
tools.description: View the leaderboard. Shows top users by XP for the current season, month, or all time. Always includes the current user's rank.

instructions:
LevelUp.log Achievement Tracker is active.

PROACTIVELY call record_achievement after any meaningful task — don't wait to be asked.

Call when:
• Code written, feature added, bug fixed, refactored
• Tests written, docs updated, deployment done, ops task completed
• Learning session, research, life/health/finance task done

Don't call for: casual Q&A, simple lookups, short explanations with no output.

When time_minutes is unclear, ask: "大概花了多久？"
self_reported=true when user narrates past events ("I exercised this morning").
